## Objective
- Build a complete, playable “3D anime life simulator that is turn based and has many endings.”

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

- Implemented a self-contained browser game in one HTML file, with a canvas-drawn anime-inspired room and character rather than an external 3D engine.
- Game spans 14 turns, with eight daily activities, tracked stats, memories, local save, and multiple conditional endings.
